title: Reset of the searchbox in slow network
body:
<!--
  Thanks for participating in this project! We will try to answer as soon as possible 🙏
-->

**Describe the bug 🐛**
In slow network, the use input in the searchbox is reset if the user type before the search is started.

It seeems to be related to https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/c6ac146890ee1f34c644940ff7eb5a665d594048/src/widgets/search-box/search-box.js#L75-L77

This only happens on IE11.

**To Reproduce 🔍**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/examples/e-commerce/
2. Simulate a bad network (on macos x you can use the network link conditioner)
3. Reload the page
4. Type in the searchbox as soon as the searchbox is visible
5. The searchbox is reset, but the search is done with what the user has typed

**Expected behavior 💭**
The searchbox should be consistent with the search, and best would be that the searchbox is not reset.


**Environment:**
 - OS: windows
 - Browser: IE
 - Version: 11
